components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The leading action within a local operation or confirmation flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #007aff); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 600 11px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A neutral operation button for ordinary or reversible actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(60 60 67 / 18%)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-muted, #f6f6f7); color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); font: 600 11px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, rgb(60 60 67 / 28%)); background: var(--surface-hover, #ededf0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: A low-chrome toolbar action whose icon carries an accessible label.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-label="Refresh resources"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6v6h-6"/><path d="M20 12a8 8 0 1 1-2.34-5.66L20 8"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #66666b); transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease, transform 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--surface-hover, #ededf0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Toolbar Search Field
components.description: The centered unified-toolbar filter for the current resource set.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input aria-label="Filter current resources" placeholder="Filter current resources"/><kbd>⌘F</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 30px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(60 60 67 / 18%)); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-muted, #f6f6f7); color: var(--text-secondary, #66666b); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); font: inherit; } .ds-search kbd { padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(60 60 67 / 18%)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--faint, #68686d); font-size: 10px; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, rgb(60 60 67 / 28%)); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus, #007aff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--focus, #007aff); }

components.name: Source List Item
components.description: A compact persistent navigation row with tonal active selection.
components.css: .ds-source-item { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 29px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #66666b); font: 600 12px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: color 100ms ease, background-color 100ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-source-item:hover { color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, #fff) 62%, transparent); } .ds-source-item[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #0059b7); background: var(--sidebar-accent, rgb(0 122 255 / 11%)); } .ds-source-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Resource Table Row
components.description: A 38px virtualized data row with a border-led scan rhythm and tonal selection.
components.css: .ds-resource-row { display: grid; width: 100%; height: 38px; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px,2fr) minmax(100px,1fr) minmax(90px,1fr) 62px 52px; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(60 60 67 / 18%)); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text-secondary, #66666b); font: 400 12px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: color 100ms ease, background-color 100ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-resource-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); font-weight: 560; } .ds-resource-name i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--healthy, #18753a); } .ds-resource-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ededf0); } .ds-resource-row[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #007aff) 11%, var(--surface, #fff)); } .ds-resource-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Line Tabs
components.description: Full-detail tabs that preserve a flat section plane and underline only the active view.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 38px; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(60 60 67 / 18%)); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #66666b); font: 500 12px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--text, #1d1d1f); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true']::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--text, #1d1d1f); content: ''; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #007aff); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact state annotation that pairs color with readable status text.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; height: 20px; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--secondary, #e9e9ec); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #1d1d1f); font: 600 10px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--healthy, #18753a); }

narrative.overview:
Aster is a restrained, professional, high-density desktop workspace. It feels native to macOS through system typography, compact controls, desktop conventions, calm neutral materials, and clear focus behavior—not through decorative chrome.

Its defining topology is a persistent Source List beside one continuous workspace, with a unified scope toolbar, dense resource table, and full-width detail flow. Aptakube authorizes that topology only; Aster's visual skin remains its own restrained combination of neutral layers, system-blue interaction, sparse orange identity, and border-led structure.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent Source List and one uninterrupted work area
Compact 29–38px navigation, control, and table rhythms
System blue for interaction, Aster orange for identity, semantic color for status
Flat tonal layering with fine separators and shadow reserved for overlays
Full-width resource detail that preserves navigation context

rules.name: The Two Accents, Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: System blue owns interaction; Aster orange owns identity. Do not swap their roles or let either dominate the neutral workspace.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red are reserved for operational meaning and never serve as decoration.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with size, weight, and density inside the system stack; do not introduce a decorative display face into the workbench.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting workspace surfaces remain shadowless; elevation is reserved for modal and popover layers.

dos: Do preserve the persistent Source List, unified toolbar, dense resource table, and full-workspace detail topology.
Do use system blue for focus, selection, navigation, and primary actions; keep Aster orange rare and brand-specific.
Do express hierarchy with neutral tonal layers, one-pixel separators, compact spacing, and clear type weight.
Do keep primary workflows keyboard-operable, visibly focused, and compatible with reduced motion.
Do pair every status color with text, an icon, or another non-color cue.
donts: Don't turn resource lists or detail sections into a card-heavy web dashboard.
Don't add decorative chrome, ornamental borders, side stripes, or resting shadows to the core workspace.
Don't borrow Aptakube's visual skin; only its approved workbench topology is part of Aster's system.
Don't use Aster orange as the general interaction color or system blue as decorative branding.
Don't hide mutation safety: dry-run state, exact Diff, read-only mode, and the final Apply action must remain explicit.
